record.reason: The paper proposes a first-order criterion for whether residual depth growth could improve a network, evaluated on ResNets and GPT-style checkpoints. It is a training-time diagnostic, not demonstrated layer pruning or LLM inference optimization.
record.title: Quantifying Depth Sufficiency in Residual Neural Networks: A First-Order Criterion
